records.failureSummary: Added FR2 acceptance tests for the store serialization surface in test/store.test.mjs, named [AC-01]..[AC-06]: toJSON shape (items + nextId), toJSON non-mutation (including immunity to mutation of the returned snapshot), fromJSON restore, per-field []/1 fallbacks for missing/invalid items and nextId, and a toJSON -> fromJSON round trip on a fresh store preserving items and nextId. Red-first: the FR2 ACs are executed against a throwaway pre-implementation copy of the module (toJSON/fromJSON still throwing) in test/red/store.test.mjs, where all six cases fail with pass 0, fail 6 and the error 'toJSON not implemented' at stub.store.mjs:37. Green: against the current src/store.mjs all six FR2 tests pass; exact final run shows ok 12..17 for [AC-01]..[AC-06], with the full suite 1..20, pass 20, fail 0, errors 0. No product code was modified. build and lint (node --check on all four src modules) exit 0. The AC test file is in-memory only and imports createStore from src/store.mjs, touching no filesystem or shared globals. Note the workspace npm test exits 0 because the T4 backend implementation is already present in the working tree; the red evidence therefore comes from the isolated stub harness, not from modifying product code. A pre-existing AC-04 ambiguity is documented: the task text reads as if both fields fall back at once, but TR6 mandates per-field normalization, so a payload with a valid nextId keeps it and only the absent items field falls back to [].
